project.title: Revolutionizing How Gamers Compete and Connect
project.description: AREENA was conceived with a clear vision: to dismantle the friction between casual multiplayer, grassroots tournaments, and tier-one professional esports. We combine real-time telemetry, automated matchmaking, automated bracket orchestration, and fair-play anti-cheat systems into a frictionless, web-native interface.
project.pillar1Desc: Deep in-game analytics, real-time match tracking, and player performance metrics powered by low-latency event pipelines.
project.pillar2Desc: Instant single-elimination, double-elimination, Swiss-system, and round-robin bracket generation with zero manual overhead.
project.pillar3Desc: Proactive server-side validation and behavioral telemetry to ensure high-integrity competitive play across every match.
project.pillar4Desc: Customizable team hubs, club leaderboards, automated prize distribution, and seamless streaming integrations.

features.title: Engineered for Peak Performance
features.feat1Desc: Smart skill-based matchmaking (SBMM) and latency-optimized routing connect players with optimal opponents in seconds.
features.feat2Desc: Built using cutting-edge open web standards, accessible from modern desktop browsers, mobile devices, and native clients.
features.feat3Desc: Secure, automated tournament prize payout pipelines guaranteeing fast, transparent distribution to winners.
features.feat4Desc: Extensible SDKs and webhook triggers allowing game studios and community organizers to embed AREENA into custom games.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Text: AREENA ('we', 'us', or 'our') respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.section2Text: We may collect account details, gaming telemetry (match history, rankings), communication records when you contact us, and technical log data (IP address, browser type) necessary for platform integrity and security.
privacy.section3Text: Your data is used strictly to provide matchmaking, orchestrate tournaments, prevent cheating, communicate critical service updates, and optimize platform performance.
privacy.section4Text: You retain full rights to request access, correction, data portability, or erasure of your personal records. Contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@areena.play.
